WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
),
counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM counts_by_type
),
above_avg_counts AS (
  SELECT cnt, (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_avg_val) as overall_avg
  FROM counts_by_type
  WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_avg_val)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cnt) as avg_count,
  AVG(cnt - overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg_counts

alternatives.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
),
counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
with_overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    cnt,
    AVG(cnt) OVER () as overall_avg
  FROM counts_by_type
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cnt) as avg_count,
  AVG(cnt - overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM with_overall_avg
WHERE cnt > overall_avg
